operations.title: Nima isolates Tor one as the external-Gram Gysin candidate grade
operations.body: Event 1231 gives a necessary physical Gysin character gate. In detH=e^2 coordinates, 1/e is externally odd; Tor_0 has trivial normal character, while the Tor_1 Koszul generator is odd. Hence density⊗Tor_1 is even and density⊗Tor_0 is odd. External orientation is distinct from the internal w involution. This selects Tor degree 1 as the only orientation-invariant candidate, but leaves unit versus trace-zero w unresolved for the source current/Gysin map.
